zh.title: 國防部偵獲7艘共艦與7艘公務船擾台 期間無共機
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲7艘共艦與7艘公務船在台海周邊活動；期間未發現共機。
body: 國防部於8月23日上午發布最新共機艦動態統計，指出自8月22日上午6時起至8月23日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲7艘次中國軍艦以及7艘次公務船，持續在台灣海峽周邊海域活動。
根據國防部公布的統計資料顯示，在上述24小時的周邊海空域監控期間內，國軍並未偵獲任何中國軍機進入或活動。
面對台海周邊海域相關艦艇活動，國防部強調，國軍已持續運用任務機、任務艦以及岸置飛彈系統，對周邊動態實施嚴密監控與適切應處。

en.title: Taiwan MND Detects 7 PLA Warships and 7 Official Vessels Near Taiwan Strait
en.summary: Taiwan's defence ministry detected seven PLA warships and seven official ships near Taiwan; no aircraft were spotted.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 23 that it detected seven Chinese naval vessels and seven official ships operating in the waters around the Taiwan Strait over a 24-hour period. The monitoring period ran from 6:00 a.m. on August 22 to 6:00 a.m. on August 23.
According to the defense ministry's released activity report, no Chinese military aircraft were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait during the same 24-hour timeframe.

The ministry emphasized that the ROC Armed Forces monitored the movements of the vessels using mission aircraft, naval ships, and land-based missile systems to maintain close surveillance and respond accordingly.
